DESIGN_NOTE: V3 HELDOUT FIX: v2 had two bugs: (1) heldout=NaN because make_two_hop_chains used_s exhausted V_C before generating heldout; (2) K_THRESH degenerate because V_P=2 fixed-pair meant only ONE chain class existed. V3 uses 3 chain classes (HIGH/MID/LOW) with VARYING training frequencies so K_THRESH actually discriminates: K=1 consolidates all 3, K=3 consolidates HIGH+MID, K=10 only HIGH, K=100 none. Heldout chains have DISJOINT s values from training (consolidator never sees them). NAIVE arm uses SEPARATE single-class chain set (beta-sweep apples-to-apples regime; W is its own); the 0.65 sanity rail is preserved.
